top_offers.title: Software Engineer, Agentic Team
top_offers.why: Lakera builds the security layer for AI agents in production and was recently absorbed into Check Point's AI hub, giving it startup speed with acquirer-backed stability. The role spans inference pipelines and red-teaming infrastructure for LLMs, a strong match for Magino's platform-engineering and AI-augmented workflow background, and it's based in Zurich.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer
top_offers.why: Tsenta is a YC-backed founding-engineer seat (team of 5) building an LLM-powered job-application agent on a TypeScript/Node stack, which lines up almost exactly with Magino's build-from-zero instincts from Alaya. The catch is it's in-person in San Francisco, a real relocation ask rather than the Geneva or remote setup he prioritizes.
